content: To bear trials with a calm mind robs misfortune of its strength and burden.
author: Seneca
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

Across his life and work, Seneca saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: What current difficulty or obstacle are you facing that could become your greatest training ground?
